newsitem.title: USA: Government Tech gets Air Force pact.
newsitem.headline: Government Tech gets Air Force pact.

text.p: Government Technology Services Inc said Friday it had been issued a blanket purchase agreement, with an estimated value of $25 million, by the Air Force Headquarters Standard Systems Group

The company said the pact runs through March 31, 1999, and features Hewlett-Packard black-and-white laser jet printers, color inkjet and laser printers, as well as user-installable options and supplies.
Government Technology Services is a government reseller providing information technology solutions.
